fulfillment.notes: LiAlvaro prints and ships. No external POD platform.

vendorCut.notes: Per-design vendorCutBps overrides this default. Cut = round(retail_line_total * bps / 10000). Owner locked default 20% (2000 bps) 2026-10-27; sample catalog kept for now.

blankCost.notes: blankCostCents on variants is owner cost for the garment blank (internal margin calc).

shipping.notes: Checkout collects address via Stripe; flat estimate until live shipping rules are set.
